# J.M. Frey

> Award-winning Canadian science fiction and fantasy author offering writing workshops, worldbuilding mentorship, and insights into the publishing industry.

J.M. Frey is a Canadian author known for works like Triptych and Time and Tide, combining fiction writing with voice acting, screenwriting, and educational content for aspiring writers. The site serves as both a portfolio and resource hub for writers seeking guidance on author platforms, worldbuilding, and publishing.

## Key Topics

- Science fiction and fantasy
- Worldbuilding
- Author website development
- Podcast interviews
- Writing workshops
- Voice acting
- Author branding
- Indie publishing
- Steampunk
- Triptych
- Time and Tide
- Canada
- Literary agents
- Audiobook narration
- SFFRomCast
